visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female pianist wearing an Attack on Titan survey corps uniform, including a brown jacket with the 'Wings of Freedom' patch, a red scarf, and dark brown boots, sits at a glossy black grand piano. Her back and side are toward the camera as she begins playing. Above her, a digital screen displays a vibrant blue stained-glass dome. (2) The upper visual frame shifts to show a young boy with brown hair standing alone in a vast field of small white flowers under a night sky. The pianist continues her performance, her hands moving gracefully over the black and white keys in the warmly lit studio setting. (3) The montage at the top cycles through various iconic scenes from the anime: the character overlooking a sunset horizon, ancient ruins, and a grand, empty hallway. The pianist remains focused, maintaining a steady posture while her fingers execute precise melodic runs across the piano's keyboard. (4) A close-up of the anime character's face appears on the top half of the screen, followed by scenes of him walking. The pianist's hand movements become more dynamic to match the rising intensity of the music, captured from a static side-view eye-level camera angle. (5) The video concludes with a silhouette of the character in the field, which then dissolves into a spectrum of glowing light. The pianist finishes the final notes, her hands resting briefly on the keys before the video ends, all set against a neutral curtain background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a solo piano performance characterized by a gentle and flowing melodic line. The recording is extremely clean, showcasing a high harmonic-to-noise ratio with no audible background hiss or environmental interference. The tempo is moderately slow, creating a sentimental and reflective mood. (2) As the piece progresses, the pianist maintains a steady rhythmic cadence. The acoustic signature suggests a professionally treated studio environment with a natural decay in the reverb. Faint mechanical sounds of the piano keys being depressed and released provide a sense of tactile realism to the performance. (3) The music transitions through several harmonic shifts, increasing in dynamic intensity while preserving its clear, tonal purity. There are no vocal elements or speech present, allowing the piano's resonant timbre to dominate the spectral field. The brightness is well-balanced, neither too sharp nor too dull. (4) The performance reaches its conclusion with a series of softer chords and a gradual slowing of the tempo. The final notes ring out with a clear, sustained decay until they fade into complete silence. The entire track exhibits excellent dynamic range and studio-grade production quality without any distortion.
